entries.reason: Authored: how far the island's top outline reaches from its centre, from an 8 m rock a few people stand on to a 20 m island, about 40 m across. Measured: the costliest island this catalog admits at 20 m (five lobes, a depth of three times the radius, the thickest rim, four fingers, weathered as islands read well: erosion 2.6 m over 9 m in three ridged octaves, varied beds 1.1 m) realized its surface at the 2 m cell in 4.6 s (cone; spires 3.5 s, bowl 3.4 s) on the development machine at a load average of 35 on 15 October 2026; at 24 m its extent reaches 64 chunks and took 19.8 s at a load average of 47, past the 10 s one island may take of a landscape's 40 s. A wider island is two volumes or a later version.
